President Mohammed Shahabuddin resigned Jul 24 2026 citing Autonomic Neuropathy. Per Article 123(2) of the Bangladesh Constitution a new president must be elected within 90 days of the vacancy (deadline: approx Oct 22 2026). The president is elected by members of parliament (Article 48). Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmad discharging presidential duties per Article 54. BNP holds supermajority in parliament following Feb 2026 landslide. Sources: Bangladesh Constitution (bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd) BBC Al Jazeera Reuters
